PMC6208734; quote verbatim. Mapping holds: Courade puts A/B within aa 15-30 (truncation beyond 24/30); WO2014028777A2 = iPierian IPN002 (aa 15-24), US20150183855A1 = WashU HJ8.5 (aa 25-30). Missed: antibody F (Lilly WO2016137811A1, MC-1 epitope) = zagotenemab, partial only.

entries.note: Shulman 'these agents' quote verbatim; Lauriet co-primary split called negative, so contra holds as a strengthening entry on the semorinemab track. Fix endpoint_role: poc_gate is TANGO's; semorinemab trials had clinical primaries.

Quote verbatim (abstract). No model-side tolerability statement is quotable from the abstract and the full text is paywalled, so untested stands. PSP phase 2 safety (Dam 2021, Hoglinger 2021) is importable but changes nothing without a model prediction.

Bright 2015 (PMID 25442111, epub 2014-09-16): quote verbatim, abstract only (Elsevier paywall). Untested opener at 2014 under rule 6. Abstract confirms AD-patient-derived neuron media eTau and two human-tau mouse lines: a distinct system, own track fine.

Shulman 2023 full text (PMC10724064): quote verbatim; Abeta42 -1.90% high dose vs -3.81% placebo confirmed. Model predicted Abeta falls; no change vs placebo: contra, downstream, direction_only. Abeta42 not a registry outcome, so 2023 holds.

Sopko 2020 full text read (fc.py): quote verbatim. Biogen's own HEK293T RD-CFP/YFP biosensor, bead immunodepletion of AD/CBD/PSP insoluble tau and rTg4510 ISF; cites Courade 2018 only as literature. Separate from Courade's assay under rule 8 (member drug's own model).

Sopko 2020 abstract (PMID 32991997, epub 2020-09-28): quote verbatim. Retro, retrodiction true right; gosuranemab, iv, HV+PSP (other_disease) match. Judgement prose still says 'Scored same rather than retro': stale, fix.

Yanamandra 2013 (PMC3924573): quote verbatim in abstract; epub 2013-09-26. Untested opener. P301S-lysate seeds in Diamond biosensor vs Courade's AD-PHF seeds gave opposite calls for the same V-region, so a separate track is right; in-vivo arm stays on the P301 track.

Florian 2023 abstract (PMID 36730056) quote verbatim; primary CDR-SB, iv, amyloid-positive early AD. Alzforum CTAD November 2021 coverage dates the AD result before the 2022-08-26 registry posting: 2021.

Sopko 2020 full text: quote verbatim. Untested opener 2020; the AD-efficacy prediction was prospective (TANGO unreported) even though the paper knew the PSP miss. Distinct procedure, seed prep, biosensor line and antibody format from Courade 2018: own track under rule 8.
Shulman CDR-SB quote verbatim; Biogen 2021-06-16 TANGO release confirmed (Alzforum), so 2021. Contra on the poc_gate; gosuranemab, iv, biomarker_selected match.

Geerts 2023 full text (PMC10474108): quote verbatim. Untested opener at model_first_use_year 2023 per rule 6. Minor: the confidence_note's 'gosuranemab AD data unreported' sentence is not in the text; gosuranemab is simulated in a 52-week PSP study (Fig. 3).

Quote verbatim; 'Both tilavonemab in PSP and semorinemab in AD failed to change clinical progression' verbatim, comparison stated. Built after the Tauriel miss (registry 2022-03-16) and fitted to observed CSF data: retro under decision 10 is right, never same.

Goff 2025 quote verbatim (PMC12256572); retro right, own model_id mcell-spatial-cleft-tau-antibody with first use 2025. Judgement still says 'kept on the QSP track as a strengthening entry': stale prose.
Same source, quote and retro call as entry 7; strengthens true right for the duplicate. Drug, route, population match entry 7.

Shulman 2023 full text (PMC10724064 via NCBI efetch): quote verbatim; all doses P<0.0001 vs placebo, -92.6% high dose; cites Sopko as ref 18. AD-patient CSF readout first public here, after Sopko 2020: same, readout direct.
Yanamandra 2013 abstract (PMID 24075978, epub 2013-09-26): quote verbatim. Untested opener for tilavonemab on the P301 track; mice were dosed intraventricularly, route iv is the patients'.

Yanamandra 2017 abstract (PMID 28424326, 2017-04-19): quote verbatim; mouse plasma-tau rise reported 'previously', so prospective. PSP patients got C2N-8E12 (tilavonemab); engagement admits other-disease dosed humans.
Yanamandra 2013 abstract sentence verbatim; untested opener for tilavonemab on the P301 track, followed by entry 14 so no untested_reason needed.
Florian 2023 abstract quote verbatim; CDR-SB missed at all doses, iv, early AD. Year 2021 from CTAD November 2021 (Alzforum). Paired with Yanamandra 2013 in-vivo arm; model_src named.
Fleisher 2024 (PMC11067698): failure quote and MC-1/JNPL3/P301S basis sentence verbatim, comparison stated; primary iADRS. Lilly October 2021 investor call (tier 5, via Alzforum) dates it 2021.
Courade 2018 full text (PMC6208734): quote verbatim. Untested opener 2018 for tilavonemab (antibody B, HJ8.5 V-region) on the AD-seed assay track.
Florian quote verbatim; weak AD-seed activity of antibody B predicted little effect and none was seen: same, partial. CTAD 2021 dating right; model_src Courade 2018.
Courade 2018 full text: 'Antibody F showed only partial activity on AD Tau.' verbatim. Untested opener 2018 for zagotenemab (MC-1 V-region) on the AD-seed assay track.
Fleisher 2024 quote verbatim; primary iADRS missed; dated to Lilly October 2021. Paired with Courade antibody F: same, partial.

missing: Engagement, P301 track, 2017: Yanamandra et al. 2017 Sci Transl Med 9:eaal2029 (doi 10.1126/scitranslmed.aal2029, PMID 28424326) put HJ8.5 in P301S mice beside ABBV-8E12 (tilavonemab lineage) in PSP patients, plasma tau rising dose-dependently in both, four years before Ayalon 2021. Qureshi 2018 (doi 10.1016/j.trci.2018.10.007; gosuranemab in healthy volunteers, CSF unbound N-terminal tau suppressed 67-97%) paired with Bright 2015 (IPN002 clearing ISF eTau in human-tau mice) is a second pre-2021 comparison.

Model with no track: iPierian's eTau model, AD-patient-derived cortical-neuron conditioned media plus two human-tau transgenic lines, in which IPN002 (gosuranemab's parent) neutralizing eTau lowered Abeta (Bright et al. 2015 Neurobiol Aging 36:693, doi 10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2014.09.007, epub 2014-09-16). Patient side: TANGO CSF Abeta42 change at week 76 was 'small and comparable between groups' (-1.90% high dose vs -3.81% placebo; Shulman 2023). A member drug's own patient-derived-cell model whose stated prediction was not met.

Mouse-seed biosensor assay (Yanamandra et al. 2013 Neuron 80:402, doi 10.1016/j.neuron.2013.07.046, PMC3924573): HJ8.5 was selected because it fully blocked P301S-brain-lysate seeding, and tilavonemab then failed (Florian 2023). It is the mouse-seed counterpart of Courade's AD-seed assay and predicted the opposite; the draft folds its in-vivo arm into the P301 mouse track but gives the selection assay no track. Courade 2018 itself contrasts the two results for antibody B.

Tier-5 record not cited: Biogen press release 2021-06-16 (https://investors.biogen.com/node/23611) reported TANGO missed CDR-SB at week 78 and discontinued gosuranemab, seventeen months before the registry posting (2022-11-08) the draft dates its 2022 entry to. Status is unchanged (tier 1 governs); the dating is a rule question. The AC Immune/Genentech Tauriel topline release (September 2020) was not verified in this check.

Within the seeding-assay track: Courade's antibody F took its V-region from WO2016137811A1 (Eli Lilly; conformational epitope aa 7-9 + 312-322, i.e. MC-1, zagotenemab's parent) and 'showed only partial activity on AD Tau'. The draft states zagotenemab was not among the reference antibodies; three of four members' V-regions were in fact tested, and the effect_size and notes should carry F.

Immunodepletion track, engagement, prospective entry: Sopko 2020's ex-vivo depletion of unbound N-terminal tau in pooled AD-patient CSF (Neurobiol Dis 146:105120, epub 2020-09-28) preceded TANGO's AD-patient CSF readout (NCT03352557 results 2022-11-08; Shulman 2023 doi 10.1038/s43587-023-00523-w, all doses P < 0.0001). After the 2020 entry is scored retro, this is the track's first prospective prediction and a fresh paired `same` under decision 10.
rule_questions: neg in a class with no successful drug: the definition needs 'the class's usual effect bar'. When every member failed, may the model's own selection bar (here UCB's antibody D, a non-member) stand as class_threshold, or is neg unavailable, which makes the one case where a model called the whole class's failure unscorable as such?

Engagement in another indication's patients: healthy volunteers count; do PSP patients (Yanamandra 2017, tilavonemab lineage) count as 'dosed humans' for an AD context, so that the stated comparison dates the engagement same to 2017 rather than 2021?

Dating against a tier-5 record: rule 6 lists registry posting, online publication, label or print as year anchors. When a sponsor press release (Biogen 2021-06-16) made a failure public before the registry posting (2022-11-08) and a tier-1 paper later set the status, does year follow the press release?

A reference antibody carrying a member's V-region in another backbone (Courade's mouse-IgG1 versions of IPN002, HJ8.5 and MC-1): is product_in_model true or false, and do its data count as 'the model's own data for a drug of this class' for neg?

Same group, same parameters, same conclusion, different numerical method: is Goff 2025's spatial Monte Carlo (MCell) cleft model the same system as Geerts 2023's ODE QSP model (one model_id, strengthening entry, as drafted) or a 'later or better model' with its own track under rule 8? Goff itself contrasts its model with 'well-mixed' models.

Same mouse ISF/CSF data (Sopko 2020) sit on two tracks: engagement 3 (P301 mice, adjudicated retro vs TANGO 2023) and engagement 9 (immunodepletion, same vs TANGO 2023 as 'first prospective prediction'). Is an AD-patient CSF readout after HV/PSP CSF results a fresh prospective test or still a retrodiction?
